info.title: MovieMov API
info.description:
Admin API for **MovieMov** (moviemov.id): post and manage movies and categories, read broken-video reports.
Everything public on the site can also be read here without a token.

## Basics

- Send `Accept: application/json` on every request, so errors come back as JSON instead of redirects.
- Write endpoints need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Get a token from `POST /login` (admin users only).
  Tokens do not expire; `POST /logout` revokes one.
- Movies and categories are addressed by **slug**: `/movies/night-train`, `/categories/sci-fi`.
- Responses use ISO 8601 times in UTC. A `published_at` you send **without an offset is read as WIB**
  (`Asia/Jakarta`, UTC+7).

## Post a movie

1. `POST /login` with `email` + `password`, copy `token`.
2. `POST /movies` with at least `title` and `embed_url`. `embed_url` may be the player URL or the whole
   `<iframe src="...">` code from the video host; `https://vidara.to/v/<id>` is turned into `https://vidara.to/e/<id>`.
3. Optional: `backup_embed_urls` (Server 2..6), `thumbnail` (file, multipart) or `thumbnail_url`, `categories`
   (names; new ones are created), `synopsis`, `release_year`, `duration_minutes`.
4. Publishing: leave `status` out to publish now, send `"status": "draft"` to hide it, or
   `"status": "scheduled"` with `published_at` to make it go live by itself later.

```sh
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST https://moviemov.id/api/login -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d email=admin@moviemov.id -d password=YOUR_PASSWORD | jq -r .token)

# JSON
curl -X POST https://moviemov.id/api/movies \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"title":"Night Train","embed_url":"<iframe src=\"https://vidara.to/e/XXXX\" allowfullscreen></iframe>",
       "categories":["Drama","Thriller"],"duration_minutes":104,"release_year":2024}'

# Multipart, with a thumbnail file (use --form-string for iframe code: curl reads a -F value starting with < as a file)
curl -X POST https://moviemov.id/api/movies -H 'Accept: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -F title='Night Train' --form-string embed_url='<iframe src="https://vidara.to/e/XXXX"></iframe>' \
  -F categories='Drama, Thriller' -F thumbnail=@night-train.jpg
```

To update a movie with a new thumbnail file use `POST /movies/{slug}` (multipart); for JSON use `PATCH`.

## Errors

`401` no/invalid token · `403` not an admin · `404` unknown slug (or a draft without an admin token) ·
`422` validation failed (`errors` lists each field) · `429` too many login attempts (5 per minute).

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Get a bearer token for the write endpoints. Only admin users can log in.

tags.name: Movies
tags.description: Movie posts: list, read, create, update, delete. Write endpoints need an admin token.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Categories shown as chips and `/category/{slug}` pages. `movies_count` counts published movies.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Free keywords on movies (actor, country, mood ...) with pages at `/tag/{slug}`. Tags are also created automatically from a movie's `tags` field. `movies_count` counts published movies.

post.description:
Exchange admin credentials for a bearer token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens do not
expire; revoke one with `POST /logout`. Wrong password or a non-admin user: 422. Limited to 5 attempts per
minute.

device_name.description: Label for the token, e.g. the tool that uses it.

post.description: Revokes the token used for this request.

get.description:
Public list of published movies, 24 per page. Filters combine freely (`q` + `category` + `tags` + `sort` +
`dir`).
With an admin token, `status` also lists drafts and scheduled movies.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
`created` = newest by publish time (default), `trending` = most views in the last 7 days (adds
`views_week`), `rating` = highest average, `views` = most viewed all time, `duration` = longest.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tag slugs, comma separated (max 5). A movie must have **all** of them.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description:
Reverse the sort with `asc` (e.g. `sort=duration&dir=asc` = shortest first). Default `desc`.
Movies without a value (e.g. no duration) are always last.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Admin token only: `scheduled`, `draft` or `all`. Anything but `published` without an admin token
returns 403.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

examples: Only admins can list drafts and scheduled movies.

post.description:
Send JSON or multipart (multipart is needed to upload a `thumbnail` file). Only `title` and `embed_url` are
required; `embed_url` may be the whole `<iframe>` code. New movies are published right away unless you send
`status` = `draft` or `scheduled` (+ `published_at`, read as WIB without an offset).

With curl multipart, send iframe code with `--form-string embed_url='<iframe ...>'`: curl reads a `-F` value
starting with `<` as a file name.

get.description: Drafts and scheduled movies return 404 unless you send an admin token.

patch.description:
Same fields as create, all optional: only the fields you send change. Use `PATCH`/`PUT` with JSON, or
`POST` with multipart to upload a new `thumbnail` file (PHP only reads uploaded files on POST).
`thumbnail_url: null` or `remove_thumbnail: true` removes the thumbnail.

put.description:
Same fields as create, all optional: only the fields you send change. Use `PATCH`/`PUT` with JSON, or
`POST` with multipart to upload a new `thumbnail` file (PHP only reads uploaded files on POST).
`thumbnail_url: null` or `remove_thumbnail: true` removes the thumbnail.

post.description:
Same fields as create, all optional: only the fields you send change. Use `PATCH`/`PUT` with JSON, or
`POST` with multipart to upload a new `thumbnail` file (PHP only reads uploaded files on POST).
`thumbnail_url: null` or `remove_thumbnail: true` removes the thumbnail.

delete.description: Also deletes its ratings, reports and uploaded thumbnail file.

post.description:
`slug` is generated from `name` when left out. Categories are also created automatically when a movie is
posted with a new category name.

patch.description: Change `name`, `slug` and/or `description`. Changing `slug` changes the category page URL.

put.description: Change `name`, `slug` and/or `description`. Changing `slug` changes the category page URL.

delete.description: The category is removed from its movies; the movies themselves are kept.

get.description:
Tags used by at least one published movie, most used first. With an admin token, `all=1` also lists unused
tags.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Admin token only: `1` also lists tags without published movies.

post.description:
`slug` is generated from `name` when left out. Usually not needed: posting a movie with a new tag name
creates the tag.

patch.description: Rename it or change its `slug` (this changes the tag page URL).

put.description: Rename it or change its `slug` (this changes the tag page URL).

delete.description: The tag is removed from its movies; the movies themselves are kept.

get.description:
One entry per movie with open reports, most reported first. `servers` and `reasons` map a server number /
reason to its count.

post.description: Marks every open report of the movie as fixed and returns how many.

name.description: Category name, shown on chips and the category page.

slug.description:
URL of the category page (`/category/{slug}`): lowercase letters, digits and single dashes, unique.
Generated from `name` when left out. Changing it changes the page URL.

description.description: Shown on the category page and used as its Google description: write 1-2 useful sentences.

slug.description:
URL path of the movie page (`/movies/{slug}`). Generated from the title when left out
(`night-train`, then `night-train-2`, ...). Changing it changes the page URL.

embed_url.description:
Player (Server 1). An `https` player URL **or the whole `<iframe src="...">` embed code** from the
video host (its `src` is used). `https://vidara.to/v/<id>` is rewritten to `https://vidara.to/e/<id>`.

thumbnail_url.description:
Thumbnail as a remote image URL (16:9 looks best). Ignored when a `thumbnail` file is sent.
`null` removes the current thumbnail.

thumbnail.description:
Thumbnail image file (multipart only): jpg, png or webp, max 2 MB, 16:9 (e.g. 1280x720).
Replaces (and deletes) the previous uploaded file.

synopsis.description: Description. The first ~155 characters become the page's Google description.
examples: A long ride through the night.

duration_minutes.description: Length in minutes. Shown as `1j 45m` / `1h 45m` and used by `sort=duration`.

categories.description:
Category names (max 10). JSON: an array. Multipart: comma separated (`Drama, Thriller`).
Matched by slug (`sci fi` = `Sci-Fi`); unknown names create a category. On update the list
replaces the old one (`[]` clears it); leave it out to keep the categories.

tags.description:
Tags: free keywords such as an actor, country or mood (max 20, each max 50 characters). JSON: an
array. Multipart: comma separated (`Korea, Tom Hanks`). Matched by slug (`tom hanks` = `Tom Hanks`);
unknown names create a tag. On update the list replaces the old one (`[]` clears it); leave it out
to keep the tags. Each tag gets a page at `/tag/{slug}`.

remove_thumbnail.description: Update only: `true` removes the current thumbnail.

published_at.description:
Publish time. Required for `scheduled` (must be in the future); for `published` it must not be in
the future. **Without an offset it is read as WIB** (`Asia/Jakarta`): `2026-11-08 20:00` =
13:00 UTC. With an offset (`+07:00`, `Z`) it is used as given. Sending `null` without `status`
makes the movie a draft.

thumbnail_url.description: Absolute thumbnail URL (uploaded file or remote image), or null.

embed_url.description: Player URL (Server 1), already extracted from iframe code.

views.description: Website page views, one per visitor session (API reads do not count).

rating_avg.description: Average visitor rating 1-5 (two decimals); `0` when unrated.

views_week.description: Only with `sort=trending`: views in the last 7 days.

published_at.description: Publish time in UTC; `null` for drafts.

url.description: Public page (Indonesian). English: the same path under `/en`.

name.description: Tag name as shown on the site (`#Korea`).

slug.description:
URL of the tag page (`/tag/{slug}`): lowercase letters, digits and single dashes, unique. Generated
from `name` when left out. Changing it changes the page URL.
